mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.3% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS hikes.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decreases below 3.5% do not correlate with subsequent CPIAUCSL increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of periods following sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST growth does not correlate with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decreases do not correlate with subsequent GDP contractions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS and UNRATE movements do not correlate with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decreases do not correlate with subsequent equity market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals strong job growth, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increases do not correlate with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods following sustained GDPC1 increases, or GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent equity market performance.
